entries.statement: Base unit mobility is bounded by the slower hero/soldier component; the guide gives the 5/3 example.
entries.scope: Base mobility only; current Global modifiers and movement profiles are not certified.

entries.statement: The card distinguishes movement after attacking from an ability allowing movement and another attack.
entries.scope: Distinct primitives only; exact duration ordering and complete hero behavior remain unverified.

entries.statement: One self-reactivating ability explicitly preserves existing buff turn counts.
entries.scope: Preservation option only; no implementation of the named real hero or its other effects.

entries.statement: The guide describes a hero performing multiple attacks within one round.
entries.scope: Clock distinction only; the real kill-triggered talent is not implemented.

entries.statement: Battle Test permits preparing and controlling both teams using the account-owned selection.
entries.scope: Collection procedure documented; no game-client test has been run by this project.

laboratory_policies: post-move completion precedes action-end timer processing
